# Dungeons & Dolphins physical-device test matrix

A row stays `Pending hardware` until run on a physical Flipper Zero. Record firmware commit, SD-card model/capacity, battery state, operator/date and observed result for failures.

| ID | Area | Action | Expected result | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BUILD-01 | Build | Build all five FAPs in the target RogueMaster tree. | All manifests/sources/assets resolve; no disabled `qsort` symbol is required. | Pending hardware/toolchain |
| NAV-01 | DNDolphins | Visit all Home destinations; Back through menus; exit. | Navigation is stable and the character is saved before exit/handoff. | Pending hardware |
| HAND-01 | Cross-FAP | Repeatedly open Adventure, Journal, Initiative and Bestiary, then return. | Source app tears down; destination opens; no progressive OOM or stale input callback. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-01 | Character storage | Create/edit/switch/reboot several characters. | Files remain directly under `/ext/apps_data/dndolphins/`; values survive reboot. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-PAGE-01 | Character paging | Create at least 40 characters and scroll from first to last and back. | Ordering remains by character ID, no entry disappears, and navigation crosses eight-record cache boundaries correctly. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-PAGE-02 | Character stress | Populate 100+ character files plus `.shd` history and repeatedly open the picker. | Heap remains stable; `.shd` files are completely ignored by picker/discovery logic. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-SHD-01 | Character shadow | Save one level repeatedly. | Matching `.shd` reflects the latest successful state with no timestamped shadow filename. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-SHD-02 | Level-up shadow | Save, raise total level, then save again. | Prior-level `.shd` remains the final pre-level-up state and the new-level `.shd` tracks current state. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-SHD-03 | Shadow retention | Delete/archive a non-main character with shadow history, then create another. | Historical `.shd` files remain untouched; profile discovery/allocation is based only on primary `.txt` files. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-SHD-04 | Shadow write failure | Make the shadow destination unavailable while the primary character path remains writable, then save. | Primary `.txt` save succeeds and remains the authoritative state; shadow failure does not set the character save to read-only/unsaved. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-XP-01 | Level XP floor | Set XP below the next level minimum and raise total level through both supported edit paths. | XP rises to the required floor; higher XP is unchanged and lowering level does not lower XP. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-02 | Unknown/future schema | Change the character version and leave only a subset of recognized fields plus unknown fields. | The readable file loads filename fallback plus every recognized field it can; it is not rejected solely for schema/version mismatch. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-03 | Character failure | Remove/reinsert SD around a normal character save/retry. | DNDolphins reports failure and character recovery behavior remains functional. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-ACTIVE-01 | Missing active character | Set the active metadata to a removed character while higher/lower valid IDs remain, then launch DNDolphins. | DNDolphins selects the next higher valid ID or wraps to the lowest valid ID and persists that selection; no `New Hero` replacement is written. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-ACTIVE-02 | Unreadable active character | Corrupt the selected primary while another valid character exists. | DNDolphins advances to another readable character; default parse data is never autosaved over the damaged/previous character. | Pending hardware |
| CHAR-ACTIVE-03 | Shadow isolation | Leave retained `.shd` data but remove all primary `.txt` files, then launch. | `.shd` files are ignored completely; normal primary-file rules determine whether a fresh character is created. | Pending hardware |
| COMBAT-MODE-01 | Attack mode | Cycle Normal/Advantage/Disadvantage, then make weapon and attack-spell rolls. | Weapon and spell attack d20s use the selected mode; damage and save/automatic spell resolution remain unchanged. | Pending hardware |
| COMBAT-SIDECAR-01 | Weapon sidecar discovery | Give a character at least one weapon and one non-weapon item, leave Inventory so its page is freed, then open Combat > Weapon Attacks. Repeat with weapons on logical item pages 0, 8 and 16. | Combat streams `ch_{id}_items.txt`, lists every weapon regardless of the previously resident page, and hydrates only the selected/visible page; non-weapons are excluded. | Pending hardware |
| COMBAT-SIDECAR-02 | Spell sidecar discovery | Give a character combat-capable spells on logical spell pages 0, 8 and 16, leave Magic so its page is freed, then open Combat > Spell Attacks. Include a cantrip and a slotted spell with an available resource. | Combat streams `ch_{id}_spellbook.txt`, finds eligible combat spells across all pages without consulting the master catalog, and does not report an empty list because of stale page/cache state. | Pending hardware |
| COMBAT-MEM-01 | Combat draw | Scroll the full Combat screen repeatedly during a long session. | No stack fault/OOM; all 22 rows render correctly despite one-row-at-a-time formatting. | Pending hardware |
| SPELLSTORE-01 | Eight-record spellbook | Load a character with 24 owned spells, remain on Home/Character/Vitals, then enter Magic and scroll across records 7/8 and 15/16 repeatedly. | Core navigation carries no spell records; Magic never has `spell_capacity` above 8; boundary navigation remains correct and leaving the spell workflow frees the page with no progressive heap loss. | Pending hardware |
| SPELLSTORE-01A | First spell / low-count allocation | Start with no `ch_{id}_spellbook.txt`, add the first spell, then add through 2, 3, 5 and 8 owned spells. | First add succeeds; capacity grows 1, 2, 4, then 8 as needed; `List is full` never appears before 24 logical spells; the newly appended spell opens immediately without an unnecessary sidecar reread. | Pending hardware |
| SPELLSTORE-02 | Catalog independence | Give a character owned spells, then reorder/change the packaged master spell catalog without changing the character sidecar. | Existing owned spells still display/use their stored data; master catalog is consulted only when Add/Change from Catalog is opened. | Pending hardware |
| SPELLSTORE-03 | No embedded migration | Put valid-looking legacy `Spell0...` / `SpellCount` fields in the core character file while `ch_{id}_spellbook.txt` is absent. | Character core loads but owned spellbook is empty; no legacy spell fields are migrated or reconstructed. | Pending hardware |
| SPELLSTORE-04 | Dirty page boundary | Edit spell 7, move to spell 8, edit spell 16, then return to the earlier pages and restart DNDolphins. | Each outgoing dirty page is written before being freed; all edits survive and no other page is overwritten. | Pending hardware |
| SPELLSTORE-05 | Whole-spell operations | With 24 spells across multiple classes, test prepared counts, class deletion/remap, long rest free-cast reset and spell-combat filtering. | Results include all 24 logical spells even though no more than eight are resident at once. | Pending hardware |
| ITEMSTORE-01 | Eight-record inventory | Load a character with 24 owned items, remain outside Inventory/Resources/weapon attacks, then scroll across records 7/8 and 15/16 repeatedly. | Core navigation carries no item records; item workflows never have `item_capacity` above 8; boundary navigation remains correct and leaving the workflow frees the page. | Pending hardware |
| ITEMSTORE-01A | First item / low-count allocation | Start with no `ch_{id}_items.txt`, add the first item, then add through 2, 3, 5 and 8 owned items. | First add succeeds; capacity grows 1, 2, 4, then 8 as needed; `List is full` never appears before 24 logical items; the newly appended item opens immediately without an unnecessary sidecar reread. | Pending hardware |
| ITEMSTORE-02 | Catalog independence | Reorder/change the packaged master item catalog after assigning items to a character. | Existing owned items remain usable from `ch_{id}_items.txt`; master catalog is required only for Add/Change from Catalog. | Pending hardware |
| ITEMSTORE-03 | No embedded migration | Put valid-looking legacy `Item0...` / `ItemCount` fields in the core character file while `ch_{id}_items.txt` is absent. | Character core loads but inventory is empty; no legacy item fields are migrated or reconstructed. | Pending hardware |
| ITEMSTORE-04 | Dirty page boundary | Edit item 7, cross to item 8, edit item 16, return to earlier pages and restart DNDolphins. | Each changed page is persisted before eviction; quantities/equipment/details remain correct and no adjacent page is overwritten. | Pending hardware |
| ITEMSTORE-05 | Whole-inventory operations | With 24 mixed items, test carried/equipped weight, attunement count, calculated AC, weapon list/rolls and ammunition changes. | Calculations and attack lists include all logical items while item capacity never exceeds eight. | Pending hardware |
| SIDECAR-01 | Record order | Manually reorder spellbook/item record lines and remove one middle record. | Remaining records load by their line contents with no numbered-variable renumbering requirement. | Pending hardware |
| SIDECAR-02 | Profile operations | Duplicate, export/import, archive and delete a character that has both sidecars. | Core character and matching sidecars follow the character as one logical set; no sidecar is mistaken for a primary character in the picker. | Pending hardware |
| SIDECAR-03 | Shadow isolation | Change only prepared/free-cast/item quantity state and leave core character fields untouched. | Matching sidecar saves, while no character `.shd` refresh occurs solely because a sidecar was hydrated or changed. | Pending hardware |
| ADV-ITEM-01 | Adventure reward lifetime | Award several items during Adventure, including incrementing an item located in each of the three 8-record pages of a 24-item inventory. | Adventure scans at most eight items at a time, saves only the matching page or appends one record, clears the page, and never retains a full inventory while continuing. | Pending hardware |
| SPELL-01 | Spell scaling | Cast mapped attack/damage spells at base and higher supported cast levels, including multi-attack/secondary-dice cases. | Structured mapping scales correctly; Notes fallback is used only where intended. | Pending hardware |
| ADV-01 | Adventure ownership | Start/switch campaigns and make progress. | Progress appears only under `/ext/apps_data/dndadventure/`; character file gains no campaign fields. | Pending hardware |
| HANDOFF-01 | Companion launch paths | Install all five FAPs under `/ext/apps/Games/`, then launch Journal, Adventure, Bestiary and Initiative from DNDolphins and return from each companion. | Every handoff uses the documented absolute `.fap` path through the shared handoff module; no app-ID-derived launch target or sibling-path resolution is required. | Pending hardware |
| HANDOFF-02 | No loaded character | Force DNDolphins to have no successfully loaded character, then open Bestiary and each character companion. | Bestiary launches without character state; Journal/Adventure/Initiative launch without an ID and apply active-profile/character-0 fallback instead of being blocked. | Pending hardware |
| HANDOFF-03 | Companion direct launch | Open Journal, Adventure and Initiative directly with no launch arguments, first with valid active metadata and then with the metadata removed. | Each uses the persisted active ID when available and character 0 otherwise. | Pending hardware |
| ADV-02 | Adventure direct write | Force a write failure while replacing campaign progress/registry. | Operation reports failure; no alternate Adventure fallback generation is consulted. | Pending hardware |
| ADV-03 | Campaign packs | Install, disable and re-enable an inbox campaign pack. | Registry/enabled index and installed files remain inside DNDAdventure. | Pending hardware |
| ADV-04 | Milestone replay | Trigger a guarded milestone, revisit the same already-granted branch. | One Journal milestone exists; replay does not intentionally duplicate it. | Pending hardware |
| ADV-STACK-04K | Adventure 4 KB stack | Repeatedly install/enable campaign packs, load scenes, make checks, grant items and hand off milestones. | No stack fault/OOM under the 4 KB reservation; scene and reward data remain correct. | Pending hardware |
| JRN-01 | Journal order | Create entries across different timestamps. | Newest entry is first with no firmware `qsort` dependency. | Pending hardware |
| JRN-PAGE-01 | Journal paging | Create more than 24 entries, then scroll through the complete list. | Entries beyond the former cap remain reachable and ordering stays newest-first across cache boundaries. | Pending hardware |
| JRN-PAGE-02 | Journal stress | Populate 100+ valid entries, repeatedly page/open/close entries. | List heap remains stable; body loads only on detail open and navigation remains functional. | Pending hardware |
| JRN-STACK-04K | Journal 4 KB stack | With 100+ entries, repeatedly cross cache boundaries, open detail, edit and return. | No stack fault/OOM with the existing 4 KB reservation and recalculated 2,664 B project-visible peak. | Pending hardware |
| JRN-02 | Journal handoff | Open a milestone and Continue Adventure. | Journal closes, Adventure opens with the same character ID, and Journal does not alter Adventure progress. | Pending hardware |
| INIT-01 | Initiative | Roll for All, advance turns, short Back, hold Back, edit HP below zero. | Controls match documented behavior and state survives reopen. | Pending hardware |
| INIT-STACK-15 | Initiative 4 KB stack | Populate 15 roster members, Roll for All, repeatedly sort/advance/back/edit/save/reopen for at least 100 combats. | No stack fault/OOM; all 15 members and combat order remain intact under the 4 KB reservation. | Pending hardware |
| VERIFY-HEAP-01 | Verify Profile transient heap / 6 KB DNDolphins stack | Repeatedly run Verify Profile on small and feature/grant-heavy readable characters, including under constrained heap conditions. | Verification succeeds with the 6 KB DNDolphins reservation and no stack fault; allocation failure returns cleanly; primary character text is not rewritten or format-migrated. | Pending hardware |
| BEST-SPARSE-340 | Bestiary sparse lookup cache | Browse the packaged 340 monsters across boundaries around 31/32/33, 319/320/321 and the final record; repeatedly reopen recently used and uncached details. | All records remain reachable; recent hints accelerate reuse; misses stream correctly; no progressive lookup-cache heap growth. | Pending hardware |
| BEST-WINDOW-15 | Bestiary 15-summary window | Page/search/filter across the full bundled catalog and favorites/recents with the 15-summary working window. | Correct totals and navigation; no stale/duplicate rows at window boundaries; browse heap stays bounded. | Pending hardware |
| BEST-STATE-HEAP | Bestiary encounter-state workspace | Repeatedly save, rename, duplicate, archive and delete maximum-size saved encounters. | No stack fault/OOM; state text remains compatible; transient reader workspace is released between scans. | Pending hardware |
| BEST-01 | Bestiary | Page/search/filter monster catalog and open long stat blocks. | No OOM/freeze and list/detail state remains usable. | Pending hardware |
| BEST-02 | Initiative transfer | Add one monster and a generated/saved encounter to Initiative. | DNDInitiative receives expected names/HP/AC/modifiers after Bestiary teardown. | Pending hardware |
| PACK-01 | Monster packs | Install/enable/disable a monster pack. | Only DNDBestiary app data changes; packaged monster assets remain read-only. | Pending hardware |
| MEM-01 | Repetition | Run 100 cross-FAP/catalog/detail cycles. | No progressive OOM, reboot, frozen input or visibly worsening responsiveness. | Pending hardware |
| LONG-01 | Long session | Perform at least 250 edits/rolls and 50 screen transitions. | UI remains responsive and saved files remain parseable. | Pending hardware |
| LONG-02 | Cross-FAP lifecycle stress | Repeatedly cycle DNDolphins -> Journal -> DNDolphins -> Adventure -> DNDolphins -> Bestiary -> DNDolphins -> Initiative -> DNDolphins for at least 25 complete cycles. | No OOM/heap degradation; each outgoing app closes before the next starts; character/campaign/journal/initiative data remain intact. | Pending hardware |

| SAVE-NOGLOBALGATE | Character save isolation | Force one optional dynamic collection to be absent while unrelated scalar/other allocated character fields remain valid, then save. | No global heap-valid/consistency predicate rejects the character; unavailable optional collection is treated locally while other fields save. | Pending hardware |
| SAVE-FILENAME-FALLBACK | Character filename fallback | Use a readable valid `ch_{id}_{name}_{level}.txt` whose body has no usable `Name=` or class-level field. | Filename name/level become fallback identity; the character is never silently renamed to `New Hero`. | Pending hardware |
| SAVE-LEGACY-FAIL | Legacy relocation failure | Make the old profiles folder readable but destination move fail while the current root has no characters. | Old file remains untouched and DNDolphins does not create a fresh character during that startup. | Pending hardware |
| SAVE-BESTEFFORT | Tolerant character load | Reorder fields, change the version value, add an unknown field and corrupt one nonessential numeric field. | Recognized remaining character fields load; file is not replaced by New Hero. | Pending hardware |
| SAVE-LEGACY-MOVE | Legacy character relocation | Place an old `ch*.txt` under `/ext/apps_data/dungeons_and_dolphins/profiles/` with no current primary using that character ID. | File moves unchanged to `/ext/apps_data/dndolphins/` and recognized character fields load. | Pending hardware |
| SAVE-SHADOW-WRITEONLY | Shadow isolation | Create multiple `.shd` files including IDs with no primary `.txt`. | Picker/recovery ignore them completely; only `.txt` files determine characters/IDs. | Pending hardware |
| INIT-NAMED | Initiative named-field recovery | Reorder Initiative fields and corrupt one member field. | Other named fields load and no 8 KB whole-file allocation is required. | Pending hardware |
| JOURNAL-NAMED | Journal named-field recovery | Reorder Journal metadata fields and corrupt one metadata field. | Remaining title/body/metadata fields load best-effort; compact `Data=` is ignored. | Pending hardware |
